inputs: Scientific unit, exposure weighting, eligible donors and information clock
Aligned unit-time panel and persistent-treatment contract
Centered matrices, covariates, transformation, lambda grid, holdouts and RNG
outputs: Fitted weights including negatives and l1 norm
Numerical status, residuals and zero-denominator states
All tuning/null-refit attempts, full grids, acceptance sets and failures
Inference law, pointwise/simultaneous scope and complete costs
refusals: Unjustified donor extrapolation or dependence law
Missing/misaligned/nonfinite inputs or unqualified solver result
Repeated-zero, empty, truncated or disconnected grid relabeled as ordinary interval
